template.label: Feature
template.description: Implement a planned behavior change with explicit acceptance criteria and verification.
template.when_to_use: Use when adding or changing user-visible behavior from an agreed request or plan.

steps.label: Confirm acceptance criteria
steps.guidance: Restate the desired behavior, constraints, and how completion will be verified.

steps.label: Design verification
steps.guidance: Decide which tests, examples, or checks will prove the behavior before implementation.

steps.label: Implement the slice
steps.guidance: Build the smallest coherent slice that satisfies the agreed criteria.

steps.label: Refine safely
steps.guidance: Review the implemented slice against the acceptance criteria and existing invariants, including scope, compatibility, and preservation. Use an available diff or a before-and-after content comparison. If refinement is warranted, keep it small and rerun the affected verification after changes. If no refinement is warranted, state why; do not change working code merely to satisfy this step. Record the review and verification results before completing it.

steps.label: Validate
steps.guidance: Run targeted and relevant broader checks; compare results to acceptance criteria.

steps.label: Handoff
steps.guidance: Summarize behavior delivered, validation, and follow-up work.
